manual_coverage.method: Every listed physical page individually inspected through tools.view_image at original PNG resolution, using the fresh immutable system Poppler 150 dpi renders. Checked readable two-page table of contents, page-number typography, flow, clipping, crowding, margins and headers/footers. Separately checked all 87 TOC PDF link annotations on physical pages 4 and 5 have in-document page targets in the 70-page PDF.

Each changed physical page was individually displayed and visually inspected at original resolution using tools.view_image(detail=original), from the immutable system Poppler 150 dpi PNG. This was a new direct inspection of every listed page, not an identity-transfer review.
Each listed final physical page was individually inspected using view_image detail original on immutable system Poppler 150 dpi page PNGs. No contact sheet substitute.
